pill.desc: colorless to light yellow solution in a single-dose prefilled syringe

tell: Its p40 target is shared by two cytokines, IL-12 and IL-23, setting this antibody apart.

clues.text: Its metabolic pathway has not been characterized. It is expected to be degraded into small peptides and amino acids through ordinary catabolic pathways.
A sterile, preservative-free solution of 1326 amino acids, supplied in single-dose prefilled syringes or vials.
Approved under a BLA as 45 mg/0.5 mL and 90 mg/mL prefilled syringes, plus 130 mg/26 mL intravenous vials; maintenance is every 8 to 12 weeks.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated with clinically significant hypersensitivity to it or its excipients; arthralgia and nausea were more frequent than with placebo.
Moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, active psoriatic arthritis, and moderately to severely active Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
It binds the p40 subunit shared by the cytokines interleukin-12 and interleukin-23, disrupting their signalling through a shared receptor chain.
The generic name begins with U and has eleven letters.
